key.name: output-mode
key.description: How to output transcribed text: 'clipboard' (paste via Ctrl+V, fast) or 'type' (per-character key events, compatibility)

key.name: model
key.description: Which Whisper model to use: 'tiny.en', 'base.en', or 'small.en'

key.name: max-duration
key.description: Recording stops and transcribes automatically after this many seconds

key.name: show-overlay
key.description: Show a visual overlay when recording

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Show notifications for transcription results and errors
